characteristics.name: purpose
characteristics.value: decompose radial/rotary reciprocating propulsion, redundancy, torque management, hybrid assist and candidate mechanisms

evidence_refs: FAA-H-8083-32B: hydraulic/liquid lock in lower radial-engine cylinders
FAA Pilot Handbook: dual magnetos and dual spark plugs
FAA-H-8083-32B Chapter 1: sodium-filled valve stems transfer heat from valve head toward stem/guide
National Air and Space Museum: rotary engine rotates engine/cylinder mass around stationary crankshaft
SAE AIR8678: electrified propulsion architectures and energy-management interfaces
SAE 2018-01-0970: driven turbo using traction drive with CVT or electric motor

SYS-ROTARY-HISTORICAL.boundary: Historical rotary engine architecture is distinct from a conventional stationary-cylinder radial engine.

SYS-ROTATING-LINER-CANDIDATE.boundary: Candidate concept only. No claim that liner rotation equalizes wear until tribology, sealing, thermal and durability evidence exists.

SYS-VALVE-THERMAL.safety_boundary: Sodium-filled valves are hazardous to cut/open; representation is documentary only.

SYS-BEARING-ARCHITECTURE.boundary: Rolling-element substitution is a topology candidate, not a blanket upgrade. Load, speed, impact, lubrication, fatigue and crankshaft assembly constraints govern suitability.

SYS-HYBRID-TORQUE-MANAGEMENT.boundary: No voltage/current/energy-storage construction recipe is encoded.

SYS-DRIVEN-BOOST-CVT.proven_reference: Driven turbo architectures using CVT or electric motor exist in published SAE work.
SYS-DRIVEN-BOOST-CVT.boundary: No boost target, shaft speed, pulley ratio or compressor sizing recipe is encoded.

SYS-START_TRANSIENT_BUFFER.purpose: reduce transient source demand during breakaway/acceleration by staging stored energy and torque paths
SYS-START_TRANSIENT_BUFFER.boundary: Conceptual energy-buffer topology only; no pressure/energy construction setpoints.

SYS-ELECTRIC-MOTOR-TOPOLOGIES.boundary: Star/delta and brushed/brushless are alternative topology families; they are not assumed simultaneously applicable to one exact machine.

SYS-TORQUE_CURVE-STAGING.goal: map each source/actuator to the operating region where its torque/power contribution is useful
SYS-TORQUE_CURVE-STAGING.boundary: Optimization target only; no operational setpoints.

SYS-FUEL-THERMAL-PRECONDITIONING.boundary: No fuel-temperature target or pressure recipe; material compatibility and vapor/cavitation limits require exact fuel/system evidence.

SYS-COMBUSTION-TRIAD.boundary: Descriptive combustion triad only. No enrichment ratio, H2/O2/N2O proportion, injection pressure or ignition recipe.
